Name: Cro-Mag Rally
Description: Race prehistoric vehicles across Stone Age tracks in Pangea's caveman kart racer. Hurl power-ups, collect tokens and bring it home in First Place.

Achievements.Name: Cro-Mag Man
Achievements.Description: Finish a race in First Place.

Achievements.Name: Old World Man
Achievements.Description: Finish a race in First, Second, or Third Place on Hard difficulty.

Achievements.Name: New World Man
Achievements.Description: Finish in First Place on all tracks.

Achievements.Name: Got the Cake... Ate it, Too
Achievements.Description: In a Gather game, collect all the tokens and come in First, Second, or Third.

Achievements.Name: Hungry Man
Achievements.Description: Collect all the tokens from all the tracks in Gather races.

Achievements.Name: Did I Mention the Clear Coat?
Achievements.Description: Complete a race with each vehicle type.

Achievements.Name: Nice View!
Achievements.Description: Stay airborne for more than 2 seconds.

Achievements.Name: Piltdown Man
Achievements.Description: Inflict damage on every opponent in a single race.

Achievements.Name: Keep it Clean
Achievements.Description: Win a race without using any power-ups.

Achievements.Name: Going for Speed
Achievements.Description: Finish Glacier in 5 minutes or less.

Achievements.Name: Omega Man
Achievements.Description: Make the Desert track less... green.
